description: Fetch one or many cards by id, in a single call. Ids join set code and collector number, e.g. "bs-4"; the historical alias "base1-4" resolves on the same route. A canonical set prefix resolves only inside that set. Unresolved ids are listed in missing, with existing historical alternatives in missing_details when the API provides them. Card game text is present since 2026-09-03, in English, and unevenly. Measured 2026-09-16: attacks on 29.9% of the catalogue, subtypes on 35.0%, weaknesses on 28.0%, flavor_text on 17.9%, abilities on 7.0%, rules on 5.1%. It sits on the 20,725 Western printings, so read against those alone attacks is on 82.9% of them, while Japanese and Chinese printings carry none. Check the field on the card in hand rather than assuming: a null attacks means we do not hold it, never that the card has no attack. Still empty for every card: level, and legalities — deck legality is a question this API cannot answer, so say so rather than inferring it. If the result carries next_step, show its handoff sentence and URL to the user verbatim and do not retry.

include_prices.description: Attach the full price list to each card.

name: ptcg_get_cards
title: Get Pokémon cards by id
